mappings.name: Change the form's calculation order, the order its fields' calculate scripts run in: the fields go together, in the order given, next to a neighbour field or to the start (`'start'`) or end (`'end'`). Every field named must have a calculate script, which puts it in the order. Returns the whole new order. - default
Set one form field's value. - default
Reset the fields named in `refs` to their default values, or the whole form without it. Returns the fields that changed. - default

Delete a widget: it leaves its page, and its field when it has one. The field survives, unplaced when this was its last widget. A widget that is its field's own dictionary is refused: delete the field. A widget is the form's, so the annotation routes refuse one. - default
Change a widget's place and look: what an annotation update takes, for a form field's widget. A widget is the form's, so the annotation routes refuse one. - default

Change the stacking order of one page's widgets: they go together, in the order given, next to a neighbour widget or to the bottom (`'start'`) or top (`'end'`) of the page's widgets, which paint above every annotation. Where the page's `/Tabs` follows it, this is also the tab order. Returns the page's new widget order. - default
Document metadata (PDF info dictionary view) for a layer. - default

The document's outline (its bookmarks) for a layer: every item, depth first, with its parent, its target in page space, its look and whether it opens. Edit it with the outline ops of a change. - default
Upsert or remove EmbedPDF calibration while preserving foreign viewports. Existing annotation scales are unchanged. - default
Read page measurement viewports in drawing order from the current layer. - default
Export the listed pages, in order, as a standalone PDF. - default
Flatten annotations and form fields into page content. - default
Register or rename a /Names /Pages entry (a named page). A page-structure mutation: the layout version advances. - default
Remove a /Names /Pages entry; the page itself stays. - default
Apply pending redactions, permanently removing content. - default
The layer view of digital signatures: revisions, every signature field with its signed state, and the protection in force. - default
Discard a pending signing candidate. - default
Install the CMS into the prepared candidate and publish the sealed bytes as the document's next base version. - default
What the layer changed after a signature (or after any revision), judged against the restrictions in force. - default
Author and seal a signing candidate; returns the digest to sign and the version fences. - default
The document's base versions, oldest first, and its head. - default
What changed between two revisions of one base version (immutable). - default
The bytes of one base version (immutable). - default
The byte prefix of one revision of a base version: exactly what a signature over it signed (immutable). - default
The signature snapshot of one base version (immutable). - default
The DER /Contents of a signed field in one base version (immutable). - default
The digest of a signed field's /ByteRange in one base version (immutable). - default
